## Usage

```js
const shebangCommand = require('shebang-command');

shebangCommand('#!/usr/bin/env node');
//=> 'node'

shebangCommand('#!/bin/bash');
//=> 'bash'
```


## API

### shebangCommand(string)

#### string

Type: `string`

String containing a shebang.
